title: Ericsson enables recycling of nearly 5,000 metric tons of e-waste in Saudi Arabia
summary: Nearly 5,000 metric tons of end-of-life telecom equipment have been collected and recycled in Saudi Arabia through the Ericsson E-Waste Management Program since 2008 The program supports circularity in the telecom sector and Saudi Arabia’s sustainability goals under the Saudi Green Initiative and Vision 2030 More than 1,000 metric tons have been recycled in the Kingdom over the past two years
body_markdown:
- Nearly 5,000 metric tons of end-of-life telecom equipment have been collected and recycled in Saudi Arabia through the Ericsson E-Waste Management Program since 2008
- The program supports circularity in the telecom sector and Saudi Arabia’s sustainability goals under the Saudi Green Initiative and Vision 2030
- More than 1,000 metric tons have been recycled in the Kingdom over the past two years
